properties.description:
Let Broccoli, templates and other repositories reuse check infrastructure without copying pipelines, preserving exact definition versions and applicability.

Scope

• Identify reusable parts of the Broccoli testing system and template integration needs.

• Design code/API-defined versioned checks/pipelines and choose a linking/pinning approach from evidence; Git submodules are an option, not a decision.

• Check/provider-owned applicability predicates with an explicit escape hatch when conventions conflict.

• Expose semantic capabilities through portable tools first; avoid dependence on Codex-specific hooks.

• Coverage evidence with computed and literal threshold provenance and system/file/function scope for critical code.

Success criteria

1. A shared check can serve Broccoli and a template without duplicated test-system implementation.

2. Runs identify the exact shared definition revision, target version and applicability reasoning; updates do not rewrite old results.

3. A user can force a check where conventions miss it, with the override visible.

4. Coverage reports distinguish measured values from thresholds, show how each threshold was obtained or overridden and expose relevant file/function coverage.

5. Follow-up scope and implementation are reviewed separately; this task is not a dependency or completion criterion of the current MVP.

Evidence

• Reusable check API and versioning proposal

• Broccoli/template example

• Applicability and coverage policy examples
properties.title: Share versioned check tooling across repositories
